display_name: LoRa W24 跨 chirp 与频带噪声拆分（Full 源域）
description: Attribute exact added-noise effects to aligned common/private chirp components and near/far FFT bins at matched readout conditions.
authorization: Active LoRa goal explicitly allows isolated source IQ and exact simulator component diagnostics, no target path, Full only.

code.environment: Archived N607 CVS-RFFI with exact registered W24 release

data.representation: Native 8192 complex samples; class scores use W24 8×2×432.
data.contract_ref: Pinned LoRa full packet native IQ contract
data.physical_ids_ref: Same 300 unique opaque source V packet IDs as frozen outer-objective source run
data.validation_ref: Exact immutable 300 V source physical IDs and seven Full views; all six frozen W24 controls checked by prediction parity.
data.leo_config_ref: Full native practical and clean. Prediction uses generated receive IQ.

permissions.claim_scope: Source-only exact simulated additive noise in a fixed diagnostic matrix. No fitting, threshold selection, or target scope. Independent source truth-last.

checkpoint.initialization: No new parameters; isolate exact source synthetic components.

sources.role: Verified frozen source DURA 40,000-step half edit and same-row reference
E104 frozen W24 default head only
Pinned original training release and checkpoint binding used for real tracker construction
Immutable direct, outer_half and oracle_exact source predictions for parity before truth-last

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Source frozen checkpoint binding and actual paired blind decisions must match the immutable prior source run.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen tracker/baseline and E104 source contract confirmed. Only unchanged source-only checkpoint weights are loaded. Exact simulated source noise runs only under the listed diagnostics.
checkpoint.selection_rule: No selection or fitting. Fixed frozen E104, outer DURA and prior exact-center score serve as source-only references.

execution.gpu_policy: N607 one context, preferred 0/3/2. Minimum 12 GiB free and fewer than eight visible contexts. Exact incumbent process count checked at launch.
execution.stop_rule: Stop on invalid source lineage or real smoke, incomplete/failing same-packet source parity, missing views or independent score failure.

metric_names: projected and remaining center noise power

rows.method: Fixed 11-row chirp and frequency noise projections against frozen exact-source diagnostic controls
rows.seed_notes: No training/model seed or support. The 300 source V panel and waveform namespace are reused. Evaluation seed identifies W24 E104.
rows.budget_ref: No training. 11 frozen readout rows, 300 physical source V packets, seven views.

notes: All diagnostics use source-only synthetic traces. No classifier training, no target scope, no candidate selection.
Verify prior direct, outer_half, and oracle_exact predictions before independent truth-last scoring.
Per-packet matched component control uses lesser observed power, with source dechirping phase kept frozen.
